triggers.name: new_row
triggers.title: New row
triggers.description: New row in a table in Snowflake secondary
triggers.help: Triggers when a row is inserted in the selected table. Checks for new rows every {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: table
input.label: Table
input.hint: Only the first 1000 are displayed. Enter name if table is not shown.

input.name: primary_key
input.label: Unique key
input.hint: Select a unique key column to deduplicate rows. Performance can be improved if the selected unique key is indexed. Learn more

input.name: output_columns
input.label: Output columns
input.hint: Choose columns to be returned from the selected table. Leave blank to return all columns.

input.name: where
input.label: WHERE condition
input.hint: Rows matching this condition will be processed, e.g. currency = 'USD' (enclose strings in single quotes)

triggers.name: new_rows_batch
triggers.title: New rows
triggers.description: New batch of rows in a table in Snowflake secondary
triggers.help: Triggers when rows are inserted in the selected table. These rows will be processed in batches. If less rows are available, trigger will deliver as a smaller batch. You can configure the batch size to be any number between 1 and 1000. Default batch size is 100.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: table
input.label: Table
input.hint: Only the first 1000 are displayed. Enter name if table is not shown.

triggers.name: scheduled_select
triggers.title: Scheduled query
triggers.description: Scheduled query using custom SQL in Snowflake secondary
triggers.help: Execute SQL query on specified schedule. Rows matching the SQL query will be processed in batches. If less rows are available, trigger will deliver as a smaller batch. You can configure the batch size to be any number between 1 and 1000. Default batch size is 100.

input.name: sql
input.label: SQL
input.hint: Provide a valid SQL string to be executed on each scheduled time. Use meaningful column aliases. If an indexed unique key of query execution result is not provided you are required to have an ‘ORDER B…

input.name: unique_key
input.label: Indexed unique key
input.hint: Provide an indexed unique key of query execution result to make execution more efficient. For queries that return more than 1000 rows, this is highly recommended to reduce load on your database

input.name: batch_size
input.label: Batch size
input.hint: Minimum is 1, maximum is 1000, default is 100

input.name: output_schema
input.label: Output fields
input.hint: Use this to manually define the columns returned in your query. Only needed when queries take too long.

actions.name: bulk_load_s3
actions.title: Bulk load data to table from stage
actions.description: Bulk load data to table from stage in Snowflake secondary
actions.help: This action loads data files from an Snowflake stage into an existing table using the COPY command.

input.name: table
input.label: Table
input.hint: Only first 1000 are displayed. Enter name if table is not shown.

input.name: stage
input.label: Stage name
input.hint: Specify the stage you would want to load the file from. Learn more.

input.name: file
input.label: File name
input.hint: Specify a list of one or more file names (separated by commas) to be loaded. If left unspecified, all files from the stage will be loaded. Learn more.

input.name: file_format
input.label: File format
input.hint: Select a named file format. Learn more.

actions.name: delete_rows
actions.title: Delete rows
actions.description: Delete rows in a table in Snowflake secondary
actions.help: Delete one or more rows in any table that matches a filter. First select the table, then specify the WHERE condition to filter the row(s) to delete.

input.name: table
input.label: Table
input.hint: Only first 1000 are displayed. Enter name if table is not shown.

input.name: where
input.label: WHERE condition
input.hint: Rows matching this condition will be deleted, e.g. currency = 'USD' (enclose strings in single quotes)

actions.name: export_csv_v2
actions.title: Export query result
actions.description: Export query result as a CSV file in Snowflake secondary
actions.help: This action executes a SQL query and exports the result into a CSV file. This action is intended to write SQL(SELECT) queries.

input.name: sql
input.label: SQL
input.hint: Export the results of this SQL (SELECT) query.

input.name: delimiter
input.label: Column delimiter
input.hint: The delimiter character that separates each column in the CSV file. CSV files typically use comma .

input.name: target_url
input.label: Upload URL
input.hint: Export the CSV file to this URL. Use the output of Generate on-prem file URL or an S3 presigned URL (with PUT method).

actions.name: insert_row
actions.title: Insert row
actions.description: Insert row in a table in Snowflake secondary
actions.help: Inserts a row in the selected table. Select the table, then provide data for the new row.

input.name: table
input.label: Table
input.hint: Only the first 1000 are displayed. Enter name if table is not shown.

actions.name: merge_action
actions.title: Merge rows
actions.description: Merge rows from source table to target table in Snowflake secondary
actions.help: Inserts or updates values in a target table based on values in a source table. Use this action to upsert rows in bulk. This action only supports merging of tables with identical schema.

input.name: source_table
input.label: Source table
input.hint: Specify the table containing the data that will be used for the merge operation. Only first 1000 are displayed. Enter name if table is not shown.

input.name: target_table
input.label: Target table
input.hint: Specify the table where data will be merged into. Only first 1000 are displayed.Enter name if table is not shown.

input.name: join_expression
input.label: Join condition

properties.name: unique_key
properties.label: Unique key
properties.hint: Select the unique key from the target table that will be used to identify duplicate rows. Both tables will be joined on this key.

input.hint: Define the join condition by selecting the unique key that identifies duplicate rows. Learn more

input.name: timeout
input.label: Timeout limit (minutes)
input.hint: Set an upper limit for this wait action. If one or more of the async jobs take longer than this, proceed to the next step without waiting. Maximum is 120 minutes.

actions.name: replicate_table_schema
actions.title: Replicate schema
actions.description: Replicate table schema in Snowflake secondary
actions.help: This table inspects the schema of a data source against a table in Snowflake.If the table does not exist in Snowflake, it will be created, else any additional column in the schema will be created in the table provided.

input.name: table
input.label: Table name
input.hint: Enter your table name here. We recommend using uppercase for table names in Snowflake. Learn more

input.name: column_case
input.label: Column case
input.hint: If set to preserve original , replicated column names will be preserved as given in the input. If not set, defaults to upcase . This allows case-insensitive queries and is recommended. Learn more

input.name: source_type
input.label: Source type
input.hint: Select the source type to replicate schema in your table.
